boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented Siena traditions connecting campus celebrations, Franciscan life, orientation, and Saints athletics.

cards.title: Christmas at Siena
cards.subtitle: Holiday gathering in Siena Hall
cards.notes: Plan for the pre-break gathering in Siena Hall, where the annual program includes a tree lighting, choir performances, hot chocolate, and Santa.
cards.short_summary: A Siena Hall holiday transformation before winter break.
cards.evidence_claim: Siena describes Christmas at Siena as an annual tradition with a tree lighting, hot chocolate, Siena College Choirs performances, and a Santa visit before winter break.
cards.access_notes: Check Siena’s event communications for the current program and attendance details.

cards.title: Homecoming Weekend
cards.subtitle: Saints, families, and alumni reunite
cards.notes: Use the weekend schedule to choose a pep rally, athletic game, Mass, reception, or dance that fits your visit and any event requirements.
cards.short_summary: A campus-wide reunion built around Saints spirit.
cards.evidence_claim: Siena says Homecoming Weekend brings together alumni, students, parents, family, and friends, with events including a pep rally, dance, Mass, reception, and athletic games.
cards.access_notes: Individual Homecoming events may have separate registration or ticket details.

cards.title: Blessing of the Brains
cards.subtitle: Finals-eve blessing and “Bs”
cards.notes: Look for this finals-eve gathering each semester; students receive a friars’ blessing and the event’s bagels, bacon, and bananas afterward.
cards.short_summary: A campus finals ritual pairing a blessing with breakfast.
cards.evidence_claim: Siena states that students gather every semester the day before finals for the Blessing of the Brains, offered by friars, followed by bagels, bacon, and bananas.
cards.access_notes: Timing follows the academic finals schedule; consult current campus announcements.

cards.title: Mr. Siena
cards.subtitle: Habitat for Humanity mock beauty pageant
cards.notes: Attend the Habitat for Humanity club’s annual mock pageant to support its student spring-break homebuilding trips and the Albany Habitat chapter.
cards.short_summary: A playful pageant with a Habitat for Humanity purpose.
cards.evidence_claim: Siena identifies Mr. Siena as an annual mock beauty pageant hosted by its Habitat for Humanity club, raising funds for student homebuilding trips and Albany Habitat for Humanity.
cards.access_notes: Confirm the annual program’s date, location, and any admission details with the club.

cards.title: Siena Fest
cards.subtitle: End-of-academic-year campus festival
cards.notes: Watch end-of-year campus programming for Siena Fest and join the festival activities, including the food and lawn games Siena highlights.
cards.evidence_claim: Siena describes Siena Fest as its end-of-the-academic-year festival and highlights food, time with friends, and cornhole as part of the experience.
cards.access_notes: See current Student Events Board announcements for the program and participation details.

cards.title: Unity Day
cards.subtitle: Juneteenth observance at Nigro Plaza
cards.notes: Join the end-of-spring-semester observance at Nigro Plaza, which lets the Siena community mark Juneteenth together before the June holiday.
cards.short_summary: A campus Juneteenth observance held while students are together.
cards.evidence_claim: Siena says it hosts an annual Unity Day at Nigro Plaza toward the end of spring semester to observe Juneteenth as a full community.
cards.access_notes: Check current campus announcements for the date and program.

cards.title: Palio Flags & Contrade
cards.subtitle: Seventeen Siena, Italy-inspired communities
cards.notes: Choose and keep your contrada flag as a Siena welcome marker, then use its animal or nature symbol to connect with the campus display at Nigro Plaza.
cards.short_summary: A campus community tradition based on Siena, Italy’s 17 contrade.
cards.evidence_claim: Siena says the 17 Italian Contrade symbols frame Nigro Family Plaza and that community members receive a flag of their choosing when they begin their Siena journey.
cards.access_notes: The flags and plaza display are tied to Siena community welcome traditions.

cards.title: Albany Cup
cards.subtitle: Annual Siena–UAlbany basketball rivalry
cards.notes: Follow the basketball schedule for the annual cross-town matchup between Siena and the University at Albany, then review the host venue’s attendance details.
cards.short_summary: The Saints’ annual basketball meeting with UAlbany.
cards.evidence_claim: Siena identifies the Albany Cup as the annual basketball game in which Siena men’s and women’s teams face cross-town rival the University at Albany.
cards.access_notes: Game location, date, and ticket requirements vary by season.

cards.title: Gold Rush Game
cards.subtitle: Gold-clad support against Iona
cards.notes: Wear gold for Siena’s annual Iona rivalry game and check the game listing early if you want to confirm current fan-promotion details.
cards.short_summary: A gold-themed Saints basketball rivalry night.
cards.evidence_claim: Siena says fans are encouraged to wear gold for the annual Gold Rush game against Iona and that the first 1,000 attendees receive a free Gold Rush T-shirt.
cards.access_notes: Confirm current game, venue, and ticket information through Siena Athletics.

cards.title: Blessing of the Animals
cards.subtitle: Family Weekend’s Francis Week conclusion
cards.notes: If visiting for Family Weekend, check whether the annual pet blessing is scheduled and follow event guidance for bringing an animal to campus.
cards.short_summary: A Family Weekend pet blessing rooted in Francis Week.
cards.evidence_claim: Siena describes the annual Blessing of the Animals during Family Weekend as the culmination of Francis Week programming connected to the Feast of Saint Francis of Assisi.
cards.access_notes: Check current Family Weekend guidance before attending with a pet.
